```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(GENESPACE)
library(here)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

# Set Up

```{r echo=FALSE}
genomeRepo <- "~/project_data/downy/genespace/genomes/"
wd <- "~/project_data/downy/genespace/"
path2mcscanx <- "/Users/yixuanyang/miniforge3/bin/"
```

parse annotation

```{r echo=FALSE}
genomes2run <- c("Peronospora_effusa", "Bremia_lactucae", "Phytophthora_sojae")
parsedPaths <- parse_annotations(
  rawGenomeRepo = genomeRepo,
  genomeDirs = genomes2run,
  genomeIDs = genomes2run,
  headerSep = NA,
  headerEntryIndex = 1,
  genespaceWd = wd)
asm2run <- c("Quesada_SQIIe_MSU1", "Quesada_SQIIe_SC1982", "Quesada_SQIIe_Phumuli")
parsedPaths <- parse_annotations(
  rawGenomeRepo = genomeRepo,
  genomeDirs = asm2run,
  genomeIDs = asm2run,
  headerSep = NA,
  headerEntryIndex = 1,
  gffIdColumn = "ID",
  genespaceWd = wd)
```

# Run Genespace

initialize

```{r message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
gpar <- init_genespace(
  wd = wd,
  nCores = 10,
  dotplots = 'never',
  path2mcscanx = path2mcscanx)

out <- run_genespace(gpar)
```
# Ripanrian plots

```{r echo=FALSE}
for (asm in asm2run){
  plot_riparian(
    gsParam = out,
    genomeIDs = c(asm, genomes2run),
    refGenome = "Peronospora_effusa",
    chrLabFontSize = 2,
    useRegions = FALSE)
}
```

# Number of Chromosomes

```{r echo=FALSE}
syntenicRegion <- file.path(wd, 'results','syntenicRegion_coordinates.csv') |> 
  fread() |> filter((genome1 %in% asm2run)& genome2 == "Peronospora_effusa") |>
  group_by(genome1)

syntenicRegion |>
  summarise(unique_chr_count = n_distinct(chr1)) |> 
  gt()
```

# Chromosome matching table for each sample v.s. P.effusa

```{r echo=FALSE}
syntenicRegion.list <- syntenicRegion |> 
  group_split() |> 
  lapply(function(x) {
    x |> group_by(chr2) |> arrange(str_rank(chr2, numeric = TRUE)) |> gt()
  })
```
